title: Radiation risks: Drivers at Vallarpadam Container Terminal call off protest

ai.summary: Drivers at Vallarpadam Container Terminal in Kochi ended a 13-day protest over radiation concerns during container scanning after a meeting with officials agreed to address health risks and conduct medical checks for 3,000 workers.

facts.claim: Drivers at Vallarpadam Container Terminal in Kochi called off their 13-day non-cooperation protest
facts.quote: Kochi, Drivers working at the DP World-operated Vallarpadam Container Terminal in Kochi on Saturday called off their 13-day non-cooperation protest over concerns about possible health risks from radiation during container scanning, officials said.

facts.claim: The protest began after Customs, following a Central government directive, decided to scan all containers at the terminal
facts.quote: The protest began after Customs, following a Central government directive, decided to scan all containers at the terminal.

facts.claim: A medical team would conduct a detailed examination of the health of around 3,000 workers
facts.quote: A medical team would also conduct a detailed examination of the health of around 3,000 workers who had been associated with the port since it began operations in 2018, and submit a report within three months.
